native_execution_semantics.best_epoch: np.argmax official VALID ROC-AUC after all100 epochs; earliest tie; no selected model restoration/checkpoint

native_execution_semantics.shuffle: One advancing global Torch process RNG, TRAIN shuffle=True. TRAIN eval reuses shuffled train_loader and therefore affects subsequent RNG order.
native_execution_semantics.skip: Training skips one total node or one graph batch; evaluation skips one total node
native_execution_semantics.source_architecture: GIN MLP and all node layers use BatchNorm; virtual-node update MLP has BatchNorm. GCN uses bond embeddings/source degree+root embedding; defaults residual=False,JK=last,mean pooling.
native_execution_semantics.training: BCEWithLogits masked by y==y; native classification mean over observed flattened labels; no custom augmentation/auxiliary loss
